name: HOLLYWOOD GIN
description: Hollywood Gin is a popular scoring variation of Gin Rummy. Instead of playing a single game, players record scores for three separate games simultaneously on a single score sheet. This format increases the strategic depth and the excitement of a match by allowing a single win to contribute to multiple game totals.

content.text: Hollywood Gin is a popular scoring variation of Gin Rummy. Instead of playing a single game, players record scores for three separate games simultaneously on a single score sheet. This format increases the strategic depth and the excitement of a match by allowing a single win to contribute to multiple game totals.
Developed in the 1930s-40s in the United States, particularly among the elite social circles of New York and Hollywood. It became the professional standard for competitive Gin Rummy matches.

Two players. Each receives ten cards per hand. The first dealer is chosen by drawing from the shuffled pack (lower card deals); thereafter the winner of the previous hand deals. In serious play both players shuffle and the non-dealer cuts.
Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: K-Q-J-10...A (Aces are always low).
